_: Recruitable gangsters (Gangster's Paradise). `before`: where they stand until recruited (story beats in data/story_gang.json recruit them, flag crew_<id>; never edit gangster beats in story.json). `home`: where they hang at the hideout once in. Loyalty 0-3 rises one step per loyalty scene (talk to them at the hideout, one per 3 days). `perk` by loyalty level. Sprites from Art Prompts 11 Batch 3 (w213-w218). 'waiting' = lines (or {text} narration) before a member is recruited; 'waiting_hint' = toast once (flag crew_hint_<id>); marlene 'sold' plays once after letter_sold, then marlene_refused.

deuce.name: Deuce
perks: Sells at +5% at the sell box
Sells at +10%
Sells at +15% and finds a coin in every chest

loyalty.text: You want to know why I don't cheat? I did, once. Uptown, a magic show, a rigged deck. The man I fooled is the man you're after, and he didn't laugh; he just took the stage. And the building. And the street.
So I play it straight now. It's the only thing he can't take.
The boys like you. The boys don't like anyone; they liked HIM, once, and look. I keep telling them you're different. Don't make me a liar, boss.
If this goes wrong uptown, I've got a little stage in a town three valleys over and a chair with your name on it. If it goes right... I've still got the stage. Either way, you've got a chair.

deuce.finale: Deuce shows the door guards a card trick they can't walk away from.
waiting: Pick a card. Any card. ...Later, then. I'll keep it warm.

mama_rosa.name: Mama Rosa
perks: Meals heal +10%
Meals heal +25%
A hot meal waits at the hideout every morning, before noon (+40% energy)

loyalty.text: My kitchen fed forty men a night, and the fire that closed it wasn't an accident. Nobody was hurt; that was the only luck in it. Somebody wanted the block. You know who. Everybody who's anybody in this city is somebody he wanted the block from.
You eat like a farmer: fast, head down. Slow down. The food's not going anywhere. For once in this crew's life, the food's not going anywhere.
My boy ran with a crew like this. He's about your age. He writes, sometimes. Not enough. ...Finish your plate. I'm not saying anything else about it, and you're not asking.

mama_rosa.finale: Mama Rosa's stew is the reason nobody in the crew goes down before the red carpet.
waiting: Sit, sit. We talk business when you've got time to eat.

specs.name: Specs
perks: Shop prices -5%
Shop prices -10%
Shop prices -10%, and bills you pass are noticed far less

loyalty.text: The tower runs on a network older than me. I've been in it since I was eleven. Not deep. Sub-basement three is on its own wire. Its own WIRE, boss. Who does that?
I found my mother's old shop on a manifest. Lot 311: her whole stall, bought up by the President's people. I've decided not to get angry about it until you're standing next to me.
When it starts, I'll go for the tower's wire. Don't wait for me. I'll be faster than you think; I'm always faster than people think.

specs.finale: Specs cuts the tower's lights from sub-basement three.
waiting: No paper, no talk. Somebody on these docks keeps a shipping manifest. Find it.
I don't talk to people without paper. It's nothing personal. It's a policy.
specs.waiting_hint: Specs wants a shipping manifest. Somebody on the docks keeps one.

ladder.name: Ladder
perks: A warning the morning before a thug raid
Raids come half as often
Ladder radios how many hostiles are on each block you walk into

loyalty.text: Four hundred and twelve trucks. Four hundred and nine went to the tower. The three that didn't went to a farm. Your farm. Before you got there. Think about that.
I was a kid on a roof when the river cities fell to him. I saw the whole thing. Nobody asked me what I saw. You asked. That's the whole reason I'm here.
From the tower roof you'd see the farm. I counted. On a clear day. I'd like to see that, after. Just once.

ladder.finale: Ladder calls every guard's position from the crane before you reach the steps.
waiting: Dock boss owns the crane. Move him and come up.
Four hundred and... don't interrupt. Come back when the docks are yours.
ladder.waiting_hint: Ladder will talk once the dock boss is beaten.

vic.name: Vic
perks: +1 melee damage
+2 melee damage
Twin strike: every third hit lands twice

loyalty.text: Val says you fight like you're apologising. Val's wrong. You fight like you're counting. We like counting.
We had a brother. Not a twin. Older. He went uptown to box for the man and came back with a stone where his heart was. He walked away from us. We're still looking. We don't talk about it.
We're talking about it.
When it starts, you go left. We go right. Nobody goes middle. The middle is where he puts the ones who think they're brave.

vic.finale: Vic and Val take the right side of the avenue and hold it.
waiting: Pit first.
Win the pit. Then we talk. Both of us.
vic.waiting_hint: Vic and Val will talk once you win the pit fights.

val.name: Val
perks: +1 defence
+2 defence
Knockback on you is halved

loyalty.text: Vic says you fight like you're counting. Vic's wrong. You fight like you've already lost once and decided not to again. We know the look.
The brother. Vic told you. I'm telling you the part Vic left out: the stone talked. In his voice. Said our names. That's what's in the tower, boss. Don't listen to it.
Right side. We hold it. Don't look back for us; Vic hates that.

val.finale: Val holds the right side of the avenue with Vic.
waiting: Vic says pit first. Vic's right.
You haven't won anything down here yet.
val.waiting_hint: Vic and Val will talk once you win the pit fights.

halo.name: Halo
perks: Ride between gangster districts (talk to Halo)
Rides are instant and free
Halo picks you up at any district: talk to her anywhere

loyalty.text: I drove for him. Three years. Never asked who was in the back. One night I caught my own eyes in the mirror and didn't like who was driving, so I drove to the sea and sat there until morning. Haven't been back.
You never quit at the containers. I keep thinking about that. Most people, there's a container. There's always a container.
Car's gassed. Engine's warm. When it's done out there on the carpet, I'll be at the curb, and we'll go wherever you say, and I won't ask who's in the back.

halo.finale: Halo's car is idling at the tower steps when the doors open.
waiting: Nobody races on these docks while the boss is watching. Fix that.
Engine's warm. You're not ready. Come back when the docks are free.
halo.waiting_hint: Halo will talk once the dock boss is beaten.

dice.name: Dice
perks: Board jobs pay +10%
Bills you pass are noticed a little less
Board jobs pay +25%

loyalty.text: I run messages because I'm fast and because nobody looks at a kid with a satchel. Half the things I've carried I've read. All of the things I've read I've forgotten. Mostly.
Okay so one I didn't forget: a message from the tower to the docks that just said FARMER and a date. The date was two days before you got here. I'm just saying.
I'm going to be there, on the avenue. I'm going to be terrified. I'm going to be there anyway. That's— I think that's what you do? Is that what you do?

dice.finale: Dice carries the word down to the town: it's over.
waiting: Can't talk, can't talk. Neon's boss has eyes everywhere.
Not while Neon's boss is up. Ask me after. Please. After.
dice.waiting_hint: Dice is too scared to talk while the Neon boss runs the street.

the_kid.name: The Kid
perks: Run speed +5%
Run speed +10%
Grinding rails: a dodge roll makes you untouchable a moment longer

loyalty.text: A hand comes out of the hood and draws a square in the air. A window. Then a line down. Then the hand closes.
...the cat sticker. Was my sister's. She's uptown. In the tower. Not a guard. Not anything. Just in there.
You get her out, I'll never say another word to anyone, ever. That's a promise. It's not even hard.

the_kid.finale: The Kid finds the service stair nobody else could, and comes back down it with news.

waiting.text: The Kid points at the boss's big sign, then at you, then shrugs and skates a slow circle.
The Kid flips the board, catches it, and looks at the boss's sign again. Not yet, then.

the_kid.waiting_hint: The Kid won't talk while the Neon boss runs the street.

doc.name: Doc
perks: Heal 1 heart when you reach the hideout, once a day
Statuses on you last half as long
Doc patches you mid-fight once per battle

loyalty.text: I patched for him uptown. Two years. The ones who came down from sub-basement three didn't need patching. They needed something I don't have a word for.

He had a daughter. Seven. She moved away with her mother, far away, and he stopped getting letters. One night he sat up alone in his office with her picture and the dark stone. By morning the stone was in his chest and the picture was gone.
I'm telling you because when you get to him, you'll want to hit him. And you should. But there's a man in there, boss. I'd stake my hands on it.

doc.finale: Doc keeps the crew breathing out there in the rain.
waiting: I don't sign on with anyone while Neon's boss is running this street.
Come and see me when Neon is quiet. Mind that cut.
doc.waiting_hint: Doc will talk once the Neon boss is beaten.

marlene.name: Marlene
perks: Sell gangster drops at +20%
Buys any item at full value (no glut at the sell box)
A relic from the tower every week

loyalty.text: I sold him his first building. A paper deal, a handshake, a man in a decent suit who said thank you. I've been trying to buy the handshake back for twenty years.
Paper is only worth what someone fears it for. You, they fear. Don't ask me why; I only know prices, and yours is going up.
When it's done, there's a deed in my safe with the right name on it. Your name. I've had it since the week you arrived. I wasn't sure I'd give it to you. I'm sure now.

marlene.finale: Marlene has the real deed waiting when you come home.
waiting: I only deal with people who run the docks. Run them, then come back.
Not today, farmer. Today I'm busy being expensive.
marlene.waiting_hint: Marlene deals with whoever runs the docks. Beat the dock boss first.

sold.text: You sold me the paper. Business is business, and our business is done.
I don't keep partners who sell what they're carrying. Nothing personal. Good luck, farmer.
Marlene tucks her ledger under her arm and walks off down the docks without looking back.

sasha.name: Sasha
perks: Thugs hesitate before attacking
Your hits on thugs land harder (+2)
Sasha opens the tower doors without the letter

loyalty.text: I carried the champion out nine times. Nine different champions. I never once got in the ring. Nobody asked. You didn't ask either; you just walked, and I came. That's the difference.
The chain's my mother's. Don't laugh. She worked the docks when they were docks. It's the only thing of hers that didn't get sold off with the old docks.
Doors, boss. Any door. Say the word and there isn't a door.

sasha.finale: Sasha walks point up the wet avenue, and nothing at the tower doors gets past her.
waiting: The champion's still standing. Fix that, then talk to me.
Win the pit first.
sasha.waiting_hint: Sasha will talk once the underground boss is beaten.
